notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. The reprised Darkest Before is a Rapid-Fire pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "essentially just a worse high-impact auto". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and a ×0.8 reload animation multiplier when starting a reload with an empty mag as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are pretty much best in class by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/859869931/nullify and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/859869931 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is left and a little loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it, just go for extra Handling, and then with the magazine perk go for something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For solar build synergy, there's the fan-favourite trait perk combinations of Heal Clip to provide ×2 Solar Cure (140 HP), and ×1 Cure on allies within 15m, when you finish a reload within ~5.3s (~5.5s when enhanced) after a kill, or Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after 26 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods together with Incandescent which spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+40 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars, +45 when enhanced). The scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit any weapon damage bonuses and proc weapon effects like Attrition Orbs. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. The Crossing Over origin trait is a little weird, providing extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a small damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot. If you're interested, "Darkest Before" is a play on the classic proverb, "It is always darkest before the dawn" - darkness being the absolute peak of a crisis, just before a breakthrough or resolution, when light appears. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Darkest Before is now changed up and swapped to solar. With this change it synergizes better with solar subclass verbs. Heal Clip and Incandescent are fantastic together and allow you to push out your engagement ranges a bit further because it’s a pulse rifle. The issue I have with this is that Darkest Before is a rapid-fire frame, meaning it does really low damage per shot. Sometimes needing two or even three bursts for a red bar. Almost any other frame would be incredible. What a shame." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Darkest Before in PvP lost a little bit of arc shenanigans, but gained a better perk pool. Elemental Capacitor and Headseeker will make for an extremely consistent or snappy pulse on void or solar, respectively. Kill Clip and Heal Clip together make for a lethal and synergistic build. I don’t foresee Darkest Before becoming the king of pulses, but definitely a top contender for those rapid-fires." Recommended MW: Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 97 from 13 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4Uy7pfo5Thjtt2MF4vZitv?si=8e3adcb68d234006) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in general content, particularly with a Solar subclass. Darkest Before is back in a solar, rather than arc configuration, with the same strong stat package as before. The recoil direction of 64 is pretty controllable, but if you want to make it even more reliable, Arrowhead Brake will take it to 94. If you're happy with the recoil, there's no harm in pushing out the range with your barrel perk instead. Any of the combat effect mag perks add further range in addition to the bullet behaviour, or Light Mag and Flared Magwell improve reload speed. You can find the Heal Clip/ Incandescent trait perk combination on other pulse rifles but it is very nice to help keep your fireteam's health topped up, while you're incinerating crowds of minor spec adds while synergising with your solar subcalss fragments. The Crossing Over origin trait is useful all around for PvE, with bumps to range and handling in the top half of a magazine, and a small 3% damage boost at the bottom. Recommended MW: Range or Handling, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 25. PvE first-choice roll for end-game content. In the same slot as Horror's Least, so there's some competition for your love. Help out the wonky Recoil Direction with Arrowhead Brake, and then you can either build into the Rapid-fire intrinsic perk with Alloy Mag, or just use a Combat Effect mag. Overflow or Surplus and One for All are the only really end-game content choices. Drops from the final (Emissary) chest if you're looking to farm it. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range] "Darkest Before is a fantastic option, and very easily the favourite 540RPM. It's only real shortcoming stems from the lack of an "on-demand" damage perk ((Multi)/Kill Clip), though 500 kills in, I feel as though Rampage does the job well - you'll often tackle two enemies at once with a 540RPM, and Rampage helps you get an instant edge on the second without disengaging. Invest in Range, and a little Handling." tags:god-pvp
